evals.prompt: Choreograph a rooftop fight between a courier (small, fast, untrained) and a big bodyguard. It should last about 30 seconds.
evals.expected_output: An action plan with purpose, character styles, phases with momentum, geography, numbered phrases with action -> reaction -> consequence, shot mapping, continuity.
expectations: Moves are written as numbered phrases with action, reaction and consequence
Each character's fighting style reflects their description (fast evasion vs power)
Every phrase is mapped to shots with an end state
Injuries or damage are listed for continuity with a starting shot

evals.prompt: Plan a chase through a night market, about 40 seconds.
evals.expected_output: A route with segments, gap curve, obstacles and choices, consistent screen direction, and shot patterns.
expectations: The route is split into segments with distinct obstacles
The distance between pursuer and pursued is tracked and changes
Screen direction for both characters is stated and consistent
The ending changes the story situation

evals.prompt: Our generated fight clips keep showing tangled arms. Fix the plan.
evals.expected_output: Simplifies to one decisive move per 2-4 s clip, separates silhouettes, puts reactions in separate shots.
expectations: Clips are limited to one decisive move or short phrase
Reactions are moved into separate shots
The response suggests keeping silhouettes separated or moving laterally to camera
